title: View and Manage AP/AR Data OFF hides the sensitive money fields on Edit Customer
custom_preconds: 1. A user has a role with Customers View and Create & Edit and View and Manage AP/AR Data OFF.
custom_steps:
1. Open the Edit Customer window for any customer.
  2. Look for these fields: Credit terms, Credit limit, Default Labor rate, Default Shop Supplies, Min and Max, Taxes, PO is required.
custom_expected:
All 7 of those fields are hidden.

Basic fields (name, address, and so on) are still shown.
viu_status: Blocked-UI (needs seeded role + Edit Customer check)
